### ✨ stardive (v1.04.12)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Locks encrypted HP at 100% and blocks all damage
- **Immortal (Death Bypass)** — Clamps player HP >= 1 so you can never die
- **Restore Full Health (Max HP)** — Instantly refills active party HP to 100%
- **One-Hit Kill (Monsters & Bosses)** — Any attack instantly slays monsters, elites & bosses
- **Damage Multiplier (Boss & Mob)** — Scales outgoing hit & skill damage to bosses & enemies
- **Always Critical Hit (100% Crit)** — Forces 100% critical hit rate & crit damage on all hits
- **No Skill & Tag Cooldown** — Instant skill recharge, full stacks & instant character switch
- **Infinite Stamina / Dodge / Dash** — Unlimited dodge rolls & sprint stamina with 0s recharge
- **Infinite MP / Ultimate Burst** — Keeps special & ultimate burst energy gauges at 100%
- **Player Action & Move Speed** — Scales character movement and attack animation speed
- **Kill All Active Enemies & Bosses** — Executes AM2PawnBase::Kill on all spawned enemies
- **Auto-Kill Enemies Loop** — Automatically kills enemy waves as they spawn
- **Freeze Enemy AI & Actions** — Freezes enemy AI controller, aggro & action speed
- **Weak Enemies & Bosses (1 HP)** — Reduces all active monsters & bosses to 1 HP
- **Auto Break / Groggy Bosses** — Disables boss & enemy super armor / break gauge
- **Auto-Collect All (Iron, Ores, Drops)** — Auto-mines Iron/Silver/Gems/Herbs & vacuums all drops
- **Instant Mine & Fast Homing** — 0s mining/gathering hold time & 25x drop magnet speed
- **Collect All Ores & Drops Now** — Gathers all Iron, Ores, Herbs & ground items in zone
- **120 FPS ProMotion Unlocker** — Forces CADisplayLink render loop to 120 Hz
- **Camera Distance / FOV Zoom** — Expands field & combat camera zoom distance
- **Root & JB Detection Shield** — Blocks Cydia, Sileo, Substrate, ElleKit, /var/jb

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
